title: Tiny Tiny Coal
description: A resource pack for the Tiny Coal mod that makes the items actually tiny.
body:
A fairly simple addon resource pack for the [Tiny Coal mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/tiny-coal) that makes the item icons "actually" tiny (compared to the default icons supplied with the mod).

### Normal Coal ###

![The normal coal item icon for comparison.](https://glektarssza.com/imgs/minecraft-mods/tiny-tiny-coal-normal.png)

### Tiny Coal Item Before Using the Resource Pack ###

![Tiny coal item icon before using the resource pack.](https://glektarssza.com/imgs/minecraft-mods/tiny-tiny-coal-before.png)

### Tiny Coal Item After Using the Resource Pack ###

![Tiny coal item icon after using the resource pack.](https://glektarssza.com/imgs/minecraft-mods/tiny-tiny-coal-after.png)
